cbs/postcode6.note: Counts are rounded to multiples of 5 and percentages to tens of percent; areas with fewer than 5 inhabitants, households or dwellings are suppressed with sentinel -99997 ('0 t/m 4 / geheim / niet aanwezig'), and -99995 marks a topic to be published in a later version.

columns.aantal_inwoners: Number of inhabitants on 1 January (registered population); rounded to multiples of 5, -99997 if fewer than 5.
columns.aantal_mannen: Number of male inhabitants on 1 January; rounded to multiples of 5.
columns.aantal_vrouwen: Number of female inhabitants on 1 January; rounded to multiples of 5.
columns.aantal_inwoners_0_tot_15_jaar: Inhabitants younger than 15 on 1 January; rounded to multiples of 5.
columns.aantal_inwoners_15_tot_25_jaar: Inhabitants aged 15 up to 25 on 1 January; rounded to multiples of 5.
columns.aantal_inwoners_25_tot_45_jaar: Inhabitants aged 25 up to 45 on 1 January; rounded to multiples of 5.
columns.aantal_inwoners_45_tot_65_jaar: Inhabitants aged 45 up to 65 on 1 January; rounded to multiples of 5.
columns.aantal_inwoners_65_jaar_en_ouder: Inhabitants aged 65 or older on 1 January; rounded to multiples of 5.
columns.aantal_geboorten: Live births during the calendar year (1 January through 31 December); rounded to multiples of 5.
columns.percentage_geb_nederland_herkomst_nederl: Share of inhabitants born in the Netherlands with both parents born in the Netherlands; rounded to tens of percent.
columns.percentage_geb_nederland_herkomst_overig: Share of inhabitants born in the Netherlands whose origin (parental birth country) is elsewhere in Europe; rounded to tens of percent.
columns.percentage_geb_nederland_herkomst_buiten: Share of inhabitants born in the Netherlands whose origin (parental birth country) is outside Europe; rounded to tens of percent.
columns.percentage_geb_buiten_nederland_herkomst: Share of inhabitants born abroad in another European country; rounded to tens of percent.
columns.percentage_geb_buiten_nederland_herkmst_: Share of inhabitants born outside Europe (Africa, Americas, Asia, Oceania); rounded to tens of percent.
columns.aantal_part_huishoudens: Private households on 1 January (institutional households excluded); rounded to multiples of 5, -99997 if fewer than 5.
columns.aantal_eenpersoonshuishoudens: Private households consisting of one person, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_meerpersoonshuishoudens_zonder_ki: Multi-person private households without children (couples without children and other households), on 1 January.
columns.aantal_eenouderhuishoudens: Private households of one parent with children living at home, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_tweeouderhuishoudens: Private households of two parents with at least one child living at home, on 1 January.
columns.gemiddelde_huishoudensgrootte: Average household size: persons living in private households divided by the number of private households, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_woningen: Total dwellings on 1 January: BAG residence objects with a residential function; rounded to multiples of 5, -99997 if fewer than 5.
columns.aantal_woningen_bouwjaar_voor_1945: Dwellings with construction year before 1945, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_woningen_bouwjaar_45_tot_65: Dwellings with construction year 1945 up to 1965, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_woningen_bouwjaar_65_tot_75: Dwellings with construction year 1965 up to 1975, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_woningen_bouwjaar_75_tot_85: Dwellings with construction year 1975 up to 1985, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_woningen_bouwjaar_85_tot_95: Dwellings with construction year 1985 up to 1995, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_woningen_bouwjaar_95_tot_05: Dwellings with construction year 1995 up to 2005, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_woningen_bouwjaar_05_tot_15: Dwellings with construction year 2005 up to 2015, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_woningen_bouwjaar_15_en_later: Dwellings with construction year 2015 or later, on 1 January.
columns.aantal_meergezins_woningen: Multi-family dwellings: flats, gallery/porch flats, upstairs/downstairs units, apartments and dwellings above business premises, 1 January.
columns.percentage_koopwoningen: Share of dwellings owned by the (future) occupants or used as second homes; rounded to tens of percent; needs >=10 dwellings, <=50% unknown ownership.
columns.percentage_huurwoningen: Share of rental dwellings (not owner-occupied; vacant dwellings counted to the rental market); rounded to tens of percent, same thresholds as koop.
columns.aantal_huurwoningen_in_bezit_woningcorpo: Rental dwellings owned by housing corporations (toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting); ownership status, not social-rent price level.
columns.aantal_niet_bewoonde_woningen: Dwellings with nobody registered in the population register (BRP) on reference date 1 January.

source.title: D2.8.III.10 INSPIRE Data Specification on Population Distribution (Demography) – Technical Guidelines v3.0.0

columns.fid: Technical: sequential feature id added in the cloud-native conversion.
columns.gid: Technical: sequential feature id added in the cloud-native conversion.
columns.OGC_FID: Technical: sequential feature id added by the OGR/GDAL conversion.
columns.geom: Feature geometry, WKB encoded; see proj:epsg for the CRS.
columns.geometry: Feature geometry, WKB encoded; see proj:epsg for the CRS.
columns.geom_bbox: Technical: per-feature bounding box struct added for spatial filtering (GeoParquet covering).
columns.geometry_bbox: Technical: per-feature bounding box struct added for spatial filtering (GeoParquet covering).
columns.bbox: Technical: per-feature bounding box struct added for spatial filtering (GeoParquet covering).
columns.gml_id2: Technical: gml:id of the second source feature merged during flattening; a join artifact, not an INSPIRE attribute.
columns.kdtree_cell: Technical: KD-tree partition cell id written by the conversion pipeline; the published file is one unpartitioned parquet.
columns.gml_id: Technical XML id of the feature in the source INSPIRE GML (gml:id); unique within the delivered file, usually derived from the INSPIRE object identifier.
columns.localId: Local identifier assigned by the data provider; unique within the namespace, so no other spatial object carries the same id (INSPIRE Identifier.localId, GCM).
columns.namespace: Namespace uniquely identifying the data source of the spatial object; owned by the data provider (INSPIRE Identifier.namespace, GCM D2.5).
columns.versionId: Identifier of this particular version of the spatial object, unique among all versions of the object; max 25 chars (INSPIRE Identifier.versionId, GCM D2.5).
columns.identifier: URI/URN form of the INSPIRE external object identifier, carried as gml:identifier in the GML encoding; combines namespace and localId.
columns.identifierScheme: Code space of gml:identifier, naming the scheme the identifier value belongs to (e.g. http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/ids); GML encoding, not a model attribute.
columns.beginLifespanVersion: Date and time at which this version of the spatial object was inserted or changed in the spatial data set (INSPIRE GCM lifecycle attribute, voidable).
columns.endLifespanVersion: Date and time at which this version of the spatial object was superseded or retired in the spatial data set (INSPIRE GCM lifecycle attribute, voidable).
columns.language: Language of the geographical name, as a three-letter code per ISO 639-3 or ISO 639-5 (GeographicalName.language, INSPIRE GN spec).
columns.nameStatus: Qualitative information on the credit to give the name regarding its standardisation and/or topicality, e.g. official (GeographicalName.nameStatus, GN spec).
columns.sourceOfName: Original data source from which the geographical name is taken and integrated in the data set providing it (GeographicalName.sourceOfName, GN spec).
columns.pronunciation: Proper, correct or standard pronunciation of the geographical name, as IPA text and/or a sound-file link (GeographicalName.pronunciation, GN spec).
columns.text: Way the name is written: the spelling text of the geographical name (SpellingOfName.text, INSPIRE GN spec).
columns.script: Set of graphic symbols the name is written in, as a four-letter ISO 15924 code, e.g. Latn (SpellingOfName.script, INSPIRE GN spec).
columns.timePosition: Timestamp value of a flattened GML time instant (gml:timePosition), carrying the actual date/time of the feature's temporal property.
columns.referencePeriod_begin: Start of the period when the data are supposed to give a picture of the territorial division in statistical units (SU referencePeriod, INSPIRE SU spec).
columns.referencePeriod_end: End of the period when the data are supposed to give a picture of the territorial division in statistical units (SU referencePeriod, INSPIRE SU spec).
columns.validityPeriod: Period when the statistical unit is supposed to be preferably used, or not (VectorStatisticalUnit.validityPeriod, INSPIRE SU spec).
columns.leastDetailedScale: Least detailed scale the generalised geometry is suitable for, as the inverse of an indicative scale (VectorStatisticalUnitGeometry, INSPIRE SU spec).
columns.areaValue: Area of the statistical unit's reference geometry (AreaStatisticalUnit.areaValue, INSPIRE SU spec).
columns.areaValue_uom: Unit of measure for areaValue, from the uom attribute of the GML Area measure (e.g. m2, km2); encoding detail, not a separate model attribute.
columns.landAreaValue: Area of the above-water part of the statistical unit (AreaStatisticalUnit.landAreaValue, INSPIRE SU spec).
columns.livableAreaValue: Area of the livable part of the statistical unit (AreaStatisticalUnit.livableAreaValue, INSPIRE SU spec).
columns.tesselation_localId: localId of the INSPIRE Identifier of the statistical tessellation this area unit composes (AreaStatisticalUnit.tessellation association, SU spec).
columns.tesselation_namespace: namespace of the INSPIRE Identifier of the statistical tessellation this area unit composes (AreaStatisticalUnit.tessellation association, SU spec).
columns.fuuid: Not defined in any INSPIRE specification; a per-feature UUID added by the ETL/flattening tooling.
columns.gmsurface: Geometry: the part of the 2D world the statistical distribution describes (StatisticalDistribution.areaOfDissemination, GM_Surface; INSPIRE PD spec).
columns.measure: The measure concerned by the distribution, e.g. population by age and gender (StatisticalDistribution.measure, INSPIRE PD spec).
columns.stat: Description of the statistic measurement method, from code list StatisticsMeasurementMethodValue (StatisticalDistribution.measurementMethod, PD spec).
columns.obsvalue: The value for the piece of datum: the observed statistical value for this unit (StatisticalValue.value, INSPIRE PD spec).
columns.obsstatus: The status of the statistical data, from code list StatisticalDataStatusValue (StatisticalValue.status, INSPIRE PD spec).
columns.periodofreference: Date or period the observation was taken and the data were collected (StatisticalDistribution.periodOfMeasurement, INSPIRE PD spec).
columns.PD_NL_LAU_T_STAT: Statistic measurement method of the LAU-level total population series (PD measurementMethod).
columns.PD_NL_LAU_T_MEASURE: Measure of the LAU-level T series; the data carries 'Population_Total'.
columns.PD_NL_LAU_PERIOD_OF_REFERENCE: Date or period the LAU-level observation was taken and the data were collected (StatisticalDistribution.periodOfMeasurement, INSPIRE PD spec).
columns.PD_NL_LAU_T_OBS_VALUE: Observed value of the LAU-level total population series (StatisticalValue.value, INSPIRE PD).
columns.PD_NL_LAU_D_STAT: Statistic measurement method of the joined LAU-level distribution variant D (PD measurementMethod); the T/D suffix is not defined by the PD spec.
columns.freq: Frequency dimension from the statistical source (SDMX; value 'A' = annual). Not an INSPIRE PD model attribute.
columns.PD_NL_LAU_D_MEASURE: Measure of the LAU-level D series; the data carries 'Population_Density' (persons per km2).
columns.PD_NL_LAU_D_OBS_VALUE: Observed value of the LAU-level population density series (StatisticalValue.value, INSPIRE PD).
columns.PD_NL_LAU_M_STAT: Statistic measurement method of the LAU-level male population series (PD measurementMethod).
columns.PD_NL_LAU_M_MEASURE: Measure of the LAU-level M series; the data carries 'Population_Male'.
columns.PD_NL_LAU_M_OBS_VALUE: Observed value of the LAU-level male population series (StatisticalValue.value, INSPIRE PD).
columns.PD_NL_LAU_F_STAT: Statistic measurement method of the LAU-level female population series (PD measurementMethod).
columns.PD_NL_LAU_F_MEASURE: Measure of the LAU-level F series; the data carries 'Population_Female'.
columns.PD_NL_LAU_F_OBS_VALUE: Observed value of the LAU-level female population series (StatisticalValue.value, INSPIRE PD).
columns.PD_NL_NUTS2_FREQ: SDMX frequency dimension of the NUTS2 series; the data carries 'A' (annual).
columns.PD_NL_NUTS2_UNIT: SDMX unit dimension of the NUTS2 series; the data carries 'NR' (number of persons).
columns.PD_NL_NUTS2_SEX: SDMX sex dimension of the NUTS2 series; the data carries 'T' (total).
columns.PD_NL_NUTS2_AGE: SDMX age dimension of the NUTS2 series; the data carries 'TOTAL' (all ages).
columns.PD_NL_NUTS2_STATCODE: Code of the NUTS 2 statistical region the observation refers to.
columns.PD_NL_NUTS2_STANAAM: Name of the NUTS 2 statistical region (Dutch province name).

source.title: CBS, Toelichting Wijk- en Buurtkaart 2023, 2024 en 2025 — 5. Beschrijving kerncijfers

cbs/wijken_en_buurten.note: CBS publishes unavailable kerncijfers as negative sentinels, not NULL. In this mirror (2025 edition) the sentinel present is -99997 (confidential or not available); the toelichting also defines -99995 and -99991. Population counts are randomly rounded to multiples of 5. Filter values < 0 before aggregating.

columns.buurtcode: Neighborhood (buurt) code: 'BU' + 8 digits = 4-digit municipality + 2-digit district + 2-digit neighborhood number (e.g. BU00030102).
columns.buurtnaam: Name of the neighborhood (buurt), the lowest regional level, delimited by the municipality and coordinated nationally by CBS.
columns.wijkcode: District (wijk) code: 'WK' + 6 digits; first 4 digits are the municipality code. A wijk is part of a municipality comprising one or more buurten.
columns.indelingswijzigingWijkenEnBuurten: Change vs previous year: 1 = code and boundary unchanged; 2 = code changed, boundary unchanged; 3 = boundary changed (figures not comparable).
columns.water: Land/water flag: JA = polygon is (larger) water surface, NEE = land, B = Belgian territory (enclaves near Baarle-Nassau, municipality GM0998).
columns.meestVoorkomendePostcode: Most common numeric (4-digit) postcode in the area, based on address counts in the Geographic Base Register (GBR) on 1 January.
columns.dekkingspercentage: Share of addresses carrying the most common postcode, in six classes (1-6): >90%, 81-90%, 71-80%, 61-70%, 51-60%, <=50%.
columns.omgevingsadressendichtheid: Environmental address density: average number of addresses per km2 within a 1 km radius around each address in the area, on 1 January.
columns.stedelijkheidAdressenPerKm2: Urbanity class from address density: 1 very highly urban (>=2500 addr/km2), 2 (1500-2500), 3 (1000-1500), 4 (500-1000), 5 not urban (<500).
columns.bevolkingsdichtheidInwonersPerKm2: Population density: inhabitants per km2 of land area.
columns.aantalInwoners: Inhabitants registered in municipal population registers on 1 January; buurt/wijk figures are randomly rounded to multiples of 5.
columns.mannen: Number of male inhabitants on 1 January.
columns.vrouwen: Number of female inhabitants on 1 January.
columns.percentagePersonen0Tot15Jaar: Inhabitants aged 0 up to 15 as a percentage of total inhabitants (1 January).
columns.percentagePersonen15Tot25Jaar: Inhabitants aged 15 up to 25 as a percentage of total inhabitants (1 January).
columns.percentagePersonen25Tot45Jaar: Inhabitants aged 25 up to 45 as a percentage of total inhabitants (1 January).
columns.percentagePersonen45Tot65Jaar: Inhabitants aged 45 up to 65 as a percentage of total inhabitants (1 January).
columns.percentagePersonen65JaarEnOuder: Inhabitants aged 65 and over as a percentage of total inhabitants (1 January).
columns.percentageOngehuwd: Percentage of inhabitants never married and never in a registered partnership.
columns.percentageGehuwd: Percentage married or in a registered partnership; includes persons legally separated (gescheiden van tafel en bed).
columns.percentageGescheid: Percentage divorced from marriage or registered partnership; legally separated persons count as married.
columns.percentageVerweduwd: Percentage widowed, including surviving partners of a registered partnership.
columns.aantalHuishoudens: Number of private households on 1 January.
columns.percentageEenpersoonshuishoudens: One-person households as a percentage of all private households.
columns.percentageHuishoudensZonderKinderen: Multi-person households without children as a percentage of all private households.
columns.percentageHuishoudensMetKinderen: Multi-person households with children as a percentage of all private households.
columns.gemiddeldeHuishoudsgrootte: Average household size: persons in private households divided by the number of private households.
columns.percentageWestersTotaal: Percentage with Western migration background: Europe (excl. Turkey), North America, Oceania, Indonesia, Japan. Editions <=2021 only.
columns.percentageNietWestersTotaal: Percentage with non-Western migration background: Turkey, Africa, Latin America, Asia excl. Indonesia and Japan. Editions <=2021 only.
columns.percentageUitMarokko: Percentage of inhabitants with a Moroccan migration background (editions <=2021 only).
columns.percentageUitNederlandseAntillenEnAruba: Percentage with a migration background from the (former) Netherlands Antilles or Aruba (editions <=2021 only).
columns.percentageUitSuriname: Percentage of inhabitants with a Surinamese migration background (editions <=2021 only).
columns.percentageUitTurkije: Percentage of inhabitants with a Turkish migration background (editions <=2021 only).
columns.percentageOverigeNietWestersemigratieach: Percentage with another non-Western migration background (excl. Morocco, Antilles/Aruba, Suriname, Turkey). Editions <=2021 only.
columns.percentageMetHerkomstlandNederland: Percentage with country of origin Netherlands. Origin = own birth country; for NL-born persons, the parents' (mother's) birth country.
columns.percentageMetHerkomstlandUitEuropaExclNl: Percentage with country of origin in Europe excl. NL (Turkey, Caucasus and Central Asia are counted under Asia).
columns.percentageMetHerkomstlandBuitenEuropa: Percentage of inhabitants with country of origin outside Europe.
columns.percentageGebInNlMetHerkomstlandNederlan: Percentage born in the Netherlands with country of origin Netherlands.
columns.percGebInNlMetHerkomstlandInEuropaExNl: Percentage born in the Netherlands with country of origin in Europe excl. the Netherlands.
columns.percGebInNlMetHerkomstlandBuitenEuropa: Percentage born in the Netherlands with country of origin outside Europe.
columns.percGebBuitenNlMetHerkomstlndInEuropaExN: Percentage born outside the Netherlands with country of origin in Europe excl. the Netherlands.
columns.percGebBuitenNlMetHerkomstlndBuitenEurop: Percentage born outside the Netherlands with country of origin outside Europe.
columns.oppervlakteTotaalInHa: Total area of the region in hectares (land plus water).
columns.oppervlakteLandInHa: Land area of the region in hectares.
columns.oppervlakteWaterInHa: Water area in hectares (inland and outer water; outer water is assigned only at municipality level).
columns.jrstatcode: Technical key: reference year concatenated with the region code, e.g. '2025BU09989999' (CBS/PDOK file key).
columns.jaar: Reference year of the Wijk- en Buurtkaart edition; most kerncijfers refer to 1 January of this year.

columns.fuuid: Technical: PDOK feature UUID; not in the CBS documentation.

columns.geom_bbox: Technical: per-feature bounding box struct added in the GeoParquet conversion for spatial indexing; not a CBS variable.

source.title: ArcGIS layer 'Primaire keringen' (Waterkeringen, layer 30) - field list and queried values

columns.Shape__Area: Esri-maintained feature area in squared units of the layer's spatial reference; a technical value, not an official surveyed area.
columns.geometry: Feature geometry, WKB encoded; see proj:epsg for the CRS.
columns.guid: Globally unique identifier (GUID) of the object, carried over from the source database.
columns.nen3610id: Persistent object id per NEN 3610, the Dutch base model for geo-information (Geonovum): <namespace>.<objecttype>.<localid>.
columns.geom: Technical: PC6 area polygon geometry (CBS source data in EPSG:28992 RD New); mirror geometry column, not a CBS statistical variable.
columns.geom_bbox: Technical: per-feature bounding box struct added in the GeoParquet conversion for spatial indexing; not a CBS variable.
columns.fid: Technical: sequential feature id added in the cloud-native conversion; not a CBS variable.
columns.NAMESPACE: Namespace of the trajectory identifier; constant 'NL99' (national register) in this dataset.
columns.TRAJECT_ID: Dike trajectory id as listed with the statutory flood-protection norms in the Waterwet/Bkl annexes (e.g. '13-5').
columns.VERSIE: Version number of the trajectory record in the NBPW (observed values 2-4).
columns.FL_BEGIN: Date field; 2016-05-09 on every row (introduction of the 2017 norm trajectories). Exact meaning of the 'FL' prefix is not published.
columns.FL_EINDE: Date field, counterpart of FL_BEGIN; null for current records. Exact meaning of 'FL' prefix not published.
columns.FH_BEGIN: Date field; varies per trajectory, consistent with the date this record version took effect. Exact meaning of 'FH' prefix not published.
columns.FH_EINDE: Date field, counterpart of FH_BEGIN; null for current records. Exact meaning of 'FH' prefix not published.
columns.NORMGRP_C: Norm group code; constant '40' in this dataset.
columns.NORMGRP_O: Norm group description; constant 'Landelijke normering primaire waterkeringen' (national norm system for primary flood defences).
columns.NORMKDR_O: Norm framework description; constant 'Waterwet' (the Water Act that anchors the dike norms).
columns.NORMTYP_ID: Norm type code: 1 = overstromingskans (flooding probability), 2 = faalkans (failure probability).
columns.NORM_SW: Signaleringswaarde: statutory signalling value, stored as x meaning a probability of 1/x per year (e.g. 30000 = 1/30,000); exceedance signals reinforcement.
columns.NORM_OG: Ondergrens: lower-limit norm (maximum allowed flooding/failure probability), stored as x meaning 1/x per year.
columns.NORM_THB: Integer, observed 0 or 10. No public definition found; do not interpret.
columns.NORM_NS: Integer, observed 0/10/100/200. No public definition found; do not interpret.
columns.WET_JN: Whether the trajectory is anchored in the Waterwet annexes (J/N); 'J' on all rows.
